A RESOLUTION AMENDING THE COUNTY BUDGET FOR THE FISCAL YEAR 2017

On this day, the 18th day of July 2017, the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners having met for the purpose of discussing and passing a resolution, amending the County budget for the 2017 fiscal year do resolve that.

Whereas, the actual expenditures of Treutlen County for the current fiscal year have changed to meet the needs of the County; and,

Whereas, the Board of Commissioners in the Budget Resolution for Fiscal Year 2017 reserved the right to amend said budget; and,

Whereas, the Board of Commissioners of Treutlen County are required to provide a balanced budget and approve all budgetary changes,

THEREFORE, upon a motion and second by the Treutlen County Commissioners, such resolution is adopted, and the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners issues the following Budget Amendment for the General Fund;
